svg.title: LandFinder — Data Sources and Guardrails
svg.desc: Left: five data sources with their access method and risk level: county tax commissioner PDFs, county public notices, GeorgiaPublicNotice through a county-scoped Playwright browser, the Walker County Messenger e-edition with OCR, and a purchased parcel shapefile. Right: the guardrails designed in: throttling and identification, county-scoped queries, no redistribution of notice content, no mass scraping of the assessor site, no automation of the deeds registry, shapefile used under its licence, and the model's extraction carrying a confidence column.
svg.text: LANDFINDER · WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM, AND WHAT THE PIPELINE REFUSES TO DO
Every feed was chosen with its terms of use in view. The legal guardrails are design decisions, not a disclaimer.

g.text: Tax Commissioner tax sales
PDF download · highest-value feed, built first
LOW
County public notices
HTML + PDF · light secondary feed
LOW
GeorgiaPublicNotice.com
Playwright, county-scoped only · primary legal-notice feed
TOS · READ-ONLY
Walker County Messenger e-edition
Playwright + OCR · free secondary feed and cross-check
LOW
Parcel and assessor data
Purchased county shapefile · the enrichment backbone
LICENCE

svg.text: Until the shapefile is imported, enrichment is skipped gracefully and
notice-based leads still flow through to the report.

g.text: Every scraper throttles and sends an identifying User-Agent.
GeorgiaPublicNotice is queried for one county only, read-only.
Notice content is never redistributed; the report carries
extracted fields and a summary, not the notice text.
The assessor site is not mass-scraped. The deeds registry is
not automated. Both are reserved for manual per-lead checks.
The purchased shapefile is used per its licence.
Model extraction writes a confidence column on every row;
rules classification runs before the model is asked anything.
Without an API key the newspaper run still works: it finds the
legal pages and dumps their text, with no structured rows.
Raw bytes are kept content-addressed, so a re-run never
re-fetches or double-counts a notice already seen.

svg.text: Deferred on purpose: Docker packaging, an interactive map over the stored
geometry, and AI-generated owner outreach letters.
